demos: Activation steering (real): 108 greedy generations from Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct with difference-of-means joy / distress / certainty vectors, 9 steering strengths × 4 prompts, plus real activation projections. Generated on this Mac for the page (scripts/steer.py). Findings: joy flips between +0.3 and +0.6‖h‖. Distress steering produces refusals, not anxious prose. Certainty leaks the literal word "Certainly". Three outputs at +1.2 collapse into off-topic tokens; their tails are hidden and labelled.
Loss masking (exact definition, illustrative conversation): per-token λp/λr weights on real Qwen2.5 tokens, and the share of training signal from prompt vs response.
Evolution strategies (illustrative): live (μ=8, λ=45)-ES on a 2-D landscape, using the same selection rule as the real ES-LoRA run on GSM8K. σ slider, tap to reposition.
IVF retrieval (illustrative): 24k points and 48 k-means lists. Moving the query shows recall@10 against the fraction scanned, extrapolated to 1B vectors.

decisions: Stack kept: Vite + React 18 + Framer Motion + Lucide. Added a 60-line prerender step (vite SSR build + renderToString per route), so every route ships as static HTML with its CSS inlined. Fonts are the LCP budget: Lighthouse's simulated slow 4G charges every font fetched before first paint. Swapping one 147 KB Newsreader opsz italic for a 22 KB italic took V0 mobile LCP from 2.86 s to 2.25 s. The variants use wght-only font files.

Deferred hydration: the prerendered HTML is complete, so the JS entry is injected after the first frame and nothing is preloaded. The ~100 KB of JS no longer competes with text and fonts. Mobile FCP dropped 0.3–0.6 s on every variant.

Zero-shift font swaps: every variant's fallback face uses size-adjust and ascent/descent overrides, measured with fontTools and then calibrated on rendered text in Chromium. Local names are full names (e.g. 'Menlo Regular'), because a bare 'Menlo' silently fails to match. This took V1 desktop CLS from 0.197 to 0.001 and the V3 write-up from 0.127 to 0.

Lighthouse method: vite preview of the production build, Lighthouse 12 default mobile (Moto G Power, slow 4G, 4× CPU) and desktop presets, best of 2 runs. is-crawlable is skipped because lab pages are deliberately noindex.
Lab is hidden: /lab/* is noindex and disallowed in robots.txt. The lab dock only renders under /lab. / currently serves V0 until you pick.

Old code removed: src/components, App.css and the abandoned Tailwind half-migration (untracked src/pages, src/lib/utils.ts, src/data) were replaced. The old site stays in git history and audit/current/.

changelog3: WHY_NOT_YET.md: v4b, v6 and v9 studied side by side. What each gets right, what holds it back, and what a combined site should be. Every candidate below states how it fixes the shared list.

Four candidates, C1–C4, listed first in /lab and here. Each is 7.5–7.9k px tall at 393 px (the favourites were 11–14k), uses his timelapse and photos, keeps every research instrument, and embeds the live MarmotSat tracker.

Live MarmotSat tracker (new shared orbit demo). It pulls the current TLE from CelesTrak (NORAD 69912), propagates with satellite.js SGP4 in the browser, and shows a three.js globe with live position, ground track, footprint and the next pass over Victoria (verified against a 1-second brute force: 12/12 passes within 1 s). The fallback is a build-time TLE cache refreshed on every build, plus an SVG map without WebGL.

Photography layer: his Toronto skyline timelapse (golden hour → night, 483 frames), cut into 80 desktop and 60 phone frames. ScrollTimelapse scrubs it on a canvas: poster first, frames coarse-to-fine after paint, posters only on Save-Data. Also 20 Unsplash photos (hotlinked, as Unsplash requires) and 8 YouTube timelapses.
Ocean-sensing instrument lifted out of v9 into a shared ocean demo; the ocean write-up now carries it. v9 keeps its own.

Fixes across all 15 variants: 'unverified' badges are off by default (lab toggle only). Beri flag ON, described as 'a food app I'm building', and 'co-founder' removed everywhere (17 places). Official org logos on every experience entry, monochrome SVG. YouTube + Unsplash added to the socials.
Proof point #2 stays MarmotSat (in orbit, verified), and Beri shows in the work sections. The proof-slot rule that let Beri take slot 2 is retired (beriProof is still exported).
Correction: PORTFOLIO_DIAGNOSIS.md called the old site's project images 'stock photography'. They were his own Unsplash photos.

Performance, found and fixed this round: every page had drifted to ~2.6–2.8 s mobile LCP. There were four causes. (1) Inline logo SVGs doubled page HTML, so they're now cached SVG files drawn with a CSS mask. (2) All demo CSS, including the new tracker's, was inlined into every first paint; now each demo loads its own CSS, and core CSS went from 18.5 to 5 KB. (3) One data chunk made every page load the steering dataset; data files are now split. (4) The big one: hero text that fades in from opacity: 0 is never counted by Chrome as an LCP candidate, so the late hydration repaint became the LCP. Entrance fades now start at 0.01 (visually identical), and hydration waits until after first paint. Result: mobile LCP ~1.4–1.7 s.
